# Link

You might say
Make this text clickable so it takes people to another page.

**Click to open another page, location, or file**·A link takes people to another page, a place on the same page, or a downloadable file. Its text should make the destination clear, and keyboard users need a visible focus state. Use a [Button](/vibe-hub/button?lang=en) for actions such as saving or submitting.

## You can say this to an AI Agent

> “
> Turn each order number into a link to its detail URL instead of attaching a click handler to plain text. Verify keyboard focus, URL copying, and browser Back returning to the order list.

### When to use it

- Open another page or website

- Jump to a section on the current page

I have read and agree to the Terms of Service
- Open documentation or a referenced source

View details →

### When NOT to use it

- Use a link to submit, save, or delete data
